title: Seven Things Our Regulars Figured Out
why: Booked or nearly-booked guests: practical regular-level details (door code, parking, off-peak, night sessions) that remove friction and show we know the place.
hook_options: Seven things our regulars figured out
No waivers, no door code. And six more.
What the regulars know about Ebb & Ember
caption: Seven things our regulars figured out: the door code only shows up after everyone signs the waiver, bring two towels, leave the metal bottle home, park in Sailor parking, Monday to Thursday is off-peak, go at night once, and The Downpour is the shortcut. Save this before your first visit. #portland #pdx #floatingsauna #columbiariver #saunaculture

slides.body: Learned the slow way, so you don't have to.

slides.headline: No waivers, no door code.
slides.body: The code shows up in your booking portal only after everyone in your party signs. Chase the group chat the night before.

slides.headline: Bring two towels, not one.
slides.body: One to sit on in the sauna. One that's still dry when you get out of the river.

slides.headline: Leave the metal water bottle home.
slides.body: It heats up fast in the sauna. Bring a non-metal bottle and keep it full the whole session.

slides.headline: Park in Sailor parking.
slides.body: Tip from a guest's review: skip the reserved spots facing the river and use Sailor parking across the road.

slides.headline: Monday to Thursday is off-peak all day.
slides.body: Social sessions run $49 off-peak and $59 peak. Friday before 5pm counts as off-peak too.

slides.headline: Go at night at least once.
slides.body: "You can see the dock lights reflecting on the river." Arianna H., Google review.

slides.headline: The Downpour is the shortcut.
slides.body: Sixty liters of cold water, one pull of the cord. The fastest way from sauna heat to wide awake.

slides.headline: Sign early. Two towels. Try a night session.
slides.body: Park across the road, book off-peak if you can, and pull the cord at least once.

slides.kicker: Save this before your first visit
slides.headline: Now you know what the regulars know.
slides.body: Floating sauna on the Columbia River in North Portland. Book at ebbandember.com.
